plaatsen.tekst: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.
Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.
And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD.
Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.
Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before
Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:
But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
[[A Psalm or Song for the sabbath day.]] It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:
I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
Praise the LORD; for the LORD is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God
Praise ye the LORD: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.
Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, even I, will sing unto the LORD; I will sing praise to the LORD God of Israel.
Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.
I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.
Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.
So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.
All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.
I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.
My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.
Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
Sing unto the LORD; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.
I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.
I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.
[[A Song or Psalm of David.]] O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:
Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.
Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
